title.narrative: Orange Corners: Pre-acceleration for female entrepreneurs in Burundi

description.narrative: This project aims to address the challenges faced by women entrepreneurs in Burundi, particularly those related to confidence, leadership, and access to entrepreneurial support networks. Despite making up a significant portion of small and micro-business owners, women in Burundi face sociocultural barriers that hinder their ability to scale businesses and access structured support. The goal of this project is to empower women by building essential skills in self-confidence, communication, and leadership, enabling them to take full advantage of entrepreneurship opportunities.To solve this problem, the project will implement a hybrid Women Power Skills (WPS) training program that focuses on developing key business skills such as pitching, negotiating, and stakeholder engagement. Additionally, a provincial roadshow will raise awareness of Orange Corners, helping to expand its reach beyond the capital city, Bujumbura, and ensuring that more women across Burundi gain access to these vital support networks. By providing targeted training and connecting women to local entrepreneurial ecosystems, the project aims to increase the number of women-led businesses and improve their growth potential.The project will be implemented across several regions of Burundi, including the capital and major provincial cities, with a focus on creating sustainable change in the entrepreneurial landscape by empowering women and fostering gender-inclusive business practices. Through this initiative, the project will contribute to broader economic development goals and the promotion of women’s empowerment in Burundi.
